item.title: FRINGE: Shake It brings after-dark glamour, burlesque, and sexy circus to Gluttony
item.description: A cheeky, adults-only favourite is back at Adelaide Fringe, with Shake It returning to The Virago at Gluttony, bringing burlesque, circus, comedy and late-night fun.

item.title: Murray-Darling Basin review calls for bold action amid environmental crisis
item.description: The decade-long review of the Murray-Darling Basin Plan launches, advocating for drastic reforms to combat severe environmental issues, including recent mass fish kills and the ongoing impact of climate change on Australia's largest river system.

item.title: Johnnie Walker Black Ruby makes its LIV Golf Adelaide debut with a signature cocktail and clubhouse experience
item.description: Johnnie Walker Black Ruby will be in the spotlight at LIV Golf Adelaide as the event’s Official Whisky, complete with a signature cocktail, clubhouse pop-up and festival vibes.

item.title: SA Arts school teacher Simela Petridis dazzles on Australian Idol with emotional audition
item.description: Adelaide arts teacher Simela Petridis delivered a deeply emotional piano-folk audition on Australian Idol, beginning what promises to be a remarkable journey.

item.title: South Australia’s top tourism operators named in Qantas Australian Tourism Awards
item.description: Dozens of South Australian tourism experiences have been named national finalists in the 2025 Qantas Australian Tourism Awards.

item.title: COMING SOON: The cafe home to “Adelaide’s Most Awesome Coffee” is expanding with bigger location
item.description: After almost a decade of pouring award-winning coffee, the much-loved Coffee Factory Café is set to grow its Port Noarlunga location, with renovations underway to transform the heritage space next door.

item.title: COMING SOON: Beloved Project Burrata gets a permanent home, bringing Italian cheese to the city this February
item.description: Adelaide’s first-ever burrata bar is opening this February, bringing an authentic taste of Puglia and delicious cheese to the city through a deeply personal family story.

item.title: Adelaide weather forecast for Tuesday February 10th and the days ahead
item.description: Here's the weather for February 10th and a look at what's to come for the rest of the week!

item.title: Guns N’ Roses set to rock Adelaide at 2026 Grand Final Concert
item.description: Guns N’ Roses will headline the 2026 bp Adelaide Grand Final Sunday Concert, promising an unforgettable close to one of Australia’s biggest sporting events.

item.title: Bathurst 2016 winners reunite with their iconic VF Commodore at the 2026 Adelaide Motorsport Festival
item.description: A decade after their Bathurst triumph, Will Davison, Jonathon Webb and the iconic STIX Holden VF Commodore will reunite on track and on stage at the 2026 Repco Adelaide Motorsport Festival.
